name: brighter
lua: local function s(n, v) local m = scenetree.findObject(n) if m then m:setField('emissiveIntensityNits', 0, tostring(v)) m:flush() m:reload() end end s('bne_city_glow', 18) s('bne_beacon', 6000) s('bne_stadium_light', 6000) s('bne_star_bulb', 8000)
